baseline.method: Independent upstream full real-data method; reference agreement only

metric_definitions.moment_relative_l2: L2 norm of matched vector-moment differences divided by reference moment L2 norm

alignment: Minimum-sum-squared-location assignment of 75 sources. No spatial transformation, vector rotation, crop or scale fit.
reference_type: Published standard-method output; not physical ground truth
tolerance_provenance: Fixed after independent oracle capture and before cleaned scoring. Conservative float64 FFT/normal-equation rerun tolerance; see test/validation.md.
